defect: The 200 response oneOf has two object branches with only optional properties and unrestricted additional properties. The documented created response {id: 1627019861106475, status: PENDING, category: UTILITY} validates against both branches, violating oneOf. The node accepts that documented response and its mock test verifies this. The pinned contract is unchanged.

The pinned contract declares GET /{media_id}, GET /{flow_id} and GET /{phone_number_id}, which are identical after path-template normalization. The harness resolves get_phone_number as GET /{flow_id}; its request check cannot distinguish these operations. The provider phone-number docs specify the node route with optional fields and a phone-number response. Separate mock fixtures verify the phone-number and flow routes and their respective published response examples.
